In a Science Laboratory, a new ML-based sensor calibration system is being tested. How would you structure a test suite to verify the system’s precision, calibration speed, and resilience to sensor noise or drift? Describe the validation criteria for each test.

[Quality Assurance Engineer-Olivia Grant] We’d build three automated test modules – one feeding known reference signals to confirm calibrated outputs stay within ±0.5 % of ground truth (precision), another measuring end‑to‑end latency to ensure calibration finishes under the 2‑second target (speed), and a third injecting varying noise levels and simulated drift to verify the model’s error never exceeds a 5 % degradation threshold (resilience). Each module runs in an isolated CI environment with reproducible datasets and logs any regressions for immediate triage.
